kanbanr 0.6.1 is installed, and this folder isn't tracked yet. I'll set it up one question at a time. Nothing has been written.

**Where should the board live?** The board is its own git repo and should sit outside the project folder.

1. `~/.cache/kanbanr-walkthroughs/togaf-v070-preview-6/project.kanbanr`, a new folder beside the project (recommended)
2. Another path you give me

No other boards exist to share.

TOGAF with sprints and releases it is. This is what that means for branching:

- Items branch from `sprint/<SP>`. There's no sprint branch until you start a sprint.
- kanbanr merges each item into its sprint branch when it reaches the integrate stage. It merges `release/<V>` into `main` at the release's last stage, tagged with the version.
- `main`, `sprint/*` and `release/*` are protected.
- Pushing is always yours. kanbanr never pushes the code repo.

**Does the project have CI?**

1. No (recommended)
2. Yes

Noted: CI is on. The pipeline will be one job on one platform. I'll file it as an item planned into the first release, and I'll ask which stages to start with when we get there.

**May the board README link the code repository** (`the-remote-server/togaf-v070-preview-6-code`)?

1. Link it (recommended if the repository is public)
2. Name it without a link (private)
3. Leave it out

Git already has an identity (`walkthrough <walkthrough@localhost>`). I'll use it for the board and the repository, so there's nothing to ask there.

The last piece is the charter. The README gives me only one line, so I've drafted what it supports and left the rest blank rather than invent it.
